summary: Banco Bradesco filed a 6-K detailing the allocation of 202,380,976 remaining unsubscribed shares from its capital increase, after the preemptive rights period ended September 4, 2026. Shareholders subscribed 402,471,777 of 604,852,753 offered shares. Remaining shares (50,217,384 common, 152,163,592 preferred) are allocated exclusively to shareholders who reserved them, exercisable September 21-25, 2026 at R$15.43 per ON share and R$17.64 per PN share, paid in cash. The filing provides allocation ratios and subscription mechanics. Watch take-up levels for dilution and pricing signals.
